description: Every TXT record on a domain, with each one identified (SPF, DKIM, DMARC, MTA-STS, TLS-RPT, BIMI, or which service's ownership token it is), plus the four underscore names a receiver reads — _dmarc, _mta-sts, _smtp._tls and default._bimi — in the same lookup. Names the three mistakes that are invisible from reading the records: more than one SPF record, which makes a receiver return permerror so SPF fails entirely; a DMARC or DKIM record published at the apex, where nothing will ever read it; and a record longer than one 255-byte TXT string. Use this before concluding a record is missing, because the usual cause of a missing DMARC record is a DMARC record at the wrong name.

domain.description: Domain to read TXT records from, e.g. "acme.com". A name beginning with an underscore, such as "_dmarc.acme.com", is read on its own.

name: lookup_txt
